summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG with persistent player progression across authored and simulation-built levels. Place sims assemble local spaces, populations and hazards around shared player, NPC, loot, crafting, combat, condition/repair and UI systems; paired doors and arrival markers connect the routes, including the sim-built Level 6.1 Snackrooms.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored cells, containers, shifting walls and hunters.
places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Utility Halls and Locked sublevel; Level 2.1 sim builds Base Alef, Refrigerator Paradise, The Edges and their agents/set pieces.
places/level3 + places/gamma (3D) - Electrical Station and Base Gamma; seeded layouts, hazards, agents, traders, generators, lifts and checkpoint; Gamma includes Marlo the smith.
places/level4 (3D) - Abandoned Office; office plan, residents, cubicles, home-claim offices, coolers, vending, lift/stairs and Base Omega.
places/level5 + places/level6 (3D) - Terror Hotel and Lights Out; Level 5 rooms, quests and portal; Level 6 dark labyrinth and sensory hazards, with a tripwire entrance to Level 6.1.

places/level61 (3D) - Level 6.1 The Snackrooms; sim-built food court with modeled diner booths and sash windows, spaced tables, vendors, Facelings and M.E.G. outpost; arrivals from Levels 4 and 6 and routes onward.
places/level7 (3D) - Thalassophobia; flooded Floating House, Seawatch, Fort Surrender, sea floor, diving bell and Level 9 hatch.
places/level8 + places/debug (3D) - Level 8 Cave Systems / 9th Road and camp route; Debug is a separate dark atmosphere and spawn.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares camera, player actions, player template and HUD; Backspace opens the main menu.
templates/player.js - ordered player behavior chain; locomotion/player controller precede swim, interaction and gameplay handlers, then critter, main-menu and view3.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - camera entry; owns presented yaw/pitch and eye position; scripts/view3.js toggles player.state.tp.
places/<place>/config.yaml + sim.js + cells - place setup and authored placements; sims construct local layouts and tick local behavior, respawns and regrowth.
sim.js - world referee cadence plus onOutOfBounds; players keep normal respawn, creatures return to state.home or are destroyed for their manager to respawn.
places/level8/sim.js + art/level8/build.py - Level 8 assembler and Blender cave-road generator; cave material is scripts/mat-cave.js.
places/level61/sim.js - Level 6.1 assembler; versioned lay() replaces l61-prefixed scene objects, then seeds Facelings and people; layExtra() adds shared mall set pieces.
scripts/ui.js and *-ui.js renderers - HUD and overlays, including menu/creator, wardrobe, loot, talk/trade/repair, build, stats, craft and Back OS.
shared: scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - shared avatar gait/heading for player and M.E.G. NPC chains; scripts/lib/body3.js provides weapon animation and rowing IK.
scripts/lib/maze.js, level1.js, level2.js, level21.js + data - per-level grids, zones and layouts used by simulations, geometry, player zone labels and creature navigation.
scripts/lib/level3.js through level8.js + path helpers - level plans, zone/route queries and navigation reused by place systems and creatures.
scripts/lib/level-kit.js + scripts/lib/npc-respawn.js - named-person management, throttling and shared NPC return timing for place sims.

scripts/lib/clothes.js, scripts/lib/critter-model.js + model/face data, scripts/mat-cloth.js - seeded avatar/NPC looks and rendered critter bodies and garments; critter2-geo.js supplies alternate critter geometry.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + level data - shared item pools, rolls, remains, parsing/descriptions and container helpers; art/props/build.py supplies modeled lockers/fridges.
scripts/lib/condition.js + scripts/lib/data/condition.yml - condition bands, weapon damage/jam/wear, armor DR/wear and repair arithmetic used by player.js, clothes.js, loot-ui.js and npc-talk.js.

scripts/lib/npc-social.js, npc-life.js, hear.js and voices.js - shared idle NPC social life, character motivations, wall-culled spatial speech and voice generation; meg-agent.js and talk.js consume these helpers.
notableExports: sim.js - cadence, tick, onOutOfBounds; places/level21/sim.js and places/level8/sim.js - cadence, tick; places/level61/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/ambient-anim.js - onSpawn, update; scripts/lib/ambient.js - fan, fanHousing, cable and DRIP, DUST, MIST, SPORES, BUBBLES, RIPPLE builders/effects.
scripts/lib/level21.js - grid, room, zone, exit and height queries/constants; scripts/lib/maze21path.js - canPass21, stepToward, cellNear.
scripts/l21-use.js - updateSchedule, ears, update; scripts/level21-geo.js - geometry; scripts/lib/chatter.js - tickChatter, CHATTER.
scripts/l61-use.js - MENUS, ears, landed, takeItem, vendExpire, ready, expire; scripts/lib/level61-extra.js - layExtra, faceling, person, PEOPLE, FACELING_IDS.
scripts/l61-staff.js - ears, update; scripts/l61-jukebox.js - STATIONS, ears, tune; scripts/lib/l61-anim.js - diner gesture clips and playGesture.
scripts/lib/condition.js - CAP, band, bandColor, wMul, jamChance, drMul, useWear, armorWearFor, cndOf, repairAmount, vendorCost; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - model and look helpers.
scripts/lib/npc-talk.js - TALK, SHOPS, dialogue/check/trade helpers including repairables and repairPrice; scripts/talk-ui.js - talkUi; scripts/swim.js - onInput, update.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo/condition, needs, money, visits, combat/rewards, clothing, snack inventory/effects and temporary jukebox groove end time.

scripts/stats.js - HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags, schema version and sheet state; initializes/migrates and spends points; Repair skill and derived repair cap/wear bonus are calculated here.
scripts/craft.js - craft UI/actions, payout redemption and hunger/thirst drain; Level 2.1 hot/humid thirst multiplier comes from level21.yml.
scripts/swim.js - player.state swimming/underwater/breath and local session swim controls, breath timer and underwater audio instance; applies drowning damage.
scripts/interact.js + scripts/lib/seat.js own focus, loot and sit state; scripts/lockpick.js owns pick state and pins; seats own occupancy.

scripts/talk.js + scripts/meg-agent.js - NPC dialogue memory/rapport/shop/follow state; meg-agent owns routines, attributes/nerve, loadout, combat, fear, cover and idle social coordination; talk.js handles shop transactions and smith-only repairs.

places/level21/sim.js owns build/people versions and hound manager; scripts/l21-use.js owns prop cooldowns, payouts/quests and survivor talk UI; places/level61/sim.js owns builtV=38, crewV and local population setup.

scripts/l61-use.js owns per-object menu/order/cooldown/tray state; scripts/l61-staff.js owns Faceling routes, interactions and gesture state; scripts/l61-jukebox.js selects playback, while player.js applies earned snack tokens and timed groove.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js behavior order: locomotion/player, swim, interact/grab/rest/mahjong/talk/build/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/horde, then critter, main-menu and view3.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.
world.config.yaml Backspace → scripts/main-menu.js; menu actions and scripts/ui.js render menu/creator; menu hides player and supplies ctx.view.camera backdrop.
engine out-of-bounds event → sim.js onOutOfBounds: player returns true for normal respawn; creature with state.home is repositioned there, otherwise destroyed for its manager to respawn.
Level 2 shutter/stair → places/level2/sim.js paired door → scripts/level-door.js crosses to level21#l21-from-l2; Level 2.1 and Level 8 use paired arrival markers for their tunnel/cave routes.
places/level21/sim.js → scripts/lib/level21.js layout and scripts/level21-geo.js geometry; hounds.js uses maze21path.js for pursuit; l21-use.js handles set pieces and Edge Smilers.
Level 2.1 and Level 8 sim props carry state.anim → scripts/ambient-anim.js → builtin/tween; ambient.js supplies fan/cable meshes and DRIP/DUST/MIST/RIPPLE FX.
places/level21/sim.js tick → chatter.js with CHATTER.level21 and voice IDs → survivor agents emit voiced nearby exchanges; l21-use.js prop handlers update local logs and player payouts.

Level 6 tripwire/l6-wire-trip and Level 4 vending route → Level 6.1 arrival markers l61-from-l6/l61-from-l4; scripts/level-door.js crosses to arrivals and returns via l61-to-l6; Level 6.1 vent leads to Level 3.

Level 6.1 sim → scripts/l61-use.js menu/vending/counter handlers; orders and vending write local order/tray state and spawn food → handlers write player.state.payout → player.js adds snack tokens to player.state.snacks; loot-ui.js presents inventory.

Level 6.1 sim → level61-extra layExtra and faceling()/person() populations → l61-staff.js service and free plate payouts; diner fixtures use l61-use.js, Wurlitzer uses l61-jukebox.js; jukebox playback/groove anim is timed out by player.js.

player.js uses lib/condition.js for weapon use condition and armor hit wear; clothes.js applies condition-scaled DR; loot-ui.js reads condition and sends inventory repair actions back to player.js; stats.js supplies Repair skill-derived wear/cap.

talk-ui.js sends selected NPC choice/check or wave/gift/dance/insult and shop buy/sell/repair via talk actions → talk.js updates rapport/inventory or executes transactions; npc-talk.js supplies dialogue, trade and repair pricing, while only role=smith can restore gear to 100%.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures, local sound/light state and red-zone variants; Level 5 cells also carry portal and quest props.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look scripts - office structure, details and varied props share the office plan; Level 7 has dedicated room/ocean geometry and furnishing variants.
scripts/l4-office.js + l4-office-geo.js - cubicle islands, phones and printers vary by placement; manager schedules rings, ambience, tasks and rewards; l4-home.js handles claims and home amenities.

scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - NPC roles, dialogue, looks and routines vary by person; meg-agent.js supplies combat and idle social behavior.
scripts/lib/craft.js + craft data - recipe category, costs, skill, bench, batch size and item family vary per recipe, including Level 8 cave materials.

places/level8/sim.js + scripts/l8-life.js + scripts/l8-use.js - coordinate-interpolated road stations share systems while hazards, harvests, caches, camp interactions, quests and payouts vary by station.

places/level21/sim.js + level21.yml + level21-geo.js - room blocks share generated hall/room structure; room type, zone height, lighting, decor and loot vary by authored grid data and deterministic hashes.

places/level61/sim.js + scripts/lib/level61-extra.js + l61-use/staff/diner/jukebox scripts - shared mall, service, animation and food interactions vary by restaurant, stock/menu, Faceling role and jukebox station; booth seats and table settings align to sim-defined coordinates.
migrationNotes: Level 2.1 grid is 30×30 at 4 m per cell (120 m square); keep level21.js passability/room zones, maze21path.js traversal and sim geometry/hound routing aligned; its rebuild V is 10.

Keep paired arrival IDs aligned: Level 2 ↔ Level 2.1 (l2-from-l21/l21-from-l2), Level 2.1 ↔ Level 8 (l21-from-l8/l8-from-l21), and Level 6 ↔ Level 6.1 (l6-from-l61/l61-from-l6); the Level 6 wire trigger also targets l61-from-l6.
Level 2.1 rebuilt fixtures/ambience are sim-managed; its peopleV reset replaces survivor agents, and roofAt belongs in place state so the ceiling check survives tick calls.

Weapon condition is player.state.cnd_<weapon>; garment condition lives in player.state.look.cnd keyed by garment token, shared across same kind/colour copies. NPC armor does not wear; preserve these keys when changing clothing or repair flows.

Level 6.1 lay() replaces l61-prefixed roots when builtV < V (currently V=38) and resets crewV; keep its seat offsets aligned to the booth GLB, table-setting coordinates aligned to sim table positions, and l61 arrival IDs aligned with Level 4/6 entrances.
Level 8 lake return trigger is at the lake bed's middle, not the wading surface; swim.js relies on bounds of tagged swimwater volumes and runs after player.js to override movement/falling.
